subject: Residency wipe request — prompts & logs (confirmation sequence)
messages:
From: Data Ops <dataops@novapay.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: security@novapay.com
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for tenant novapay-prod-us

Hi Mina,

We need Redwood to execute a scoped purge for tenant `novapay-prod-us` to remove all prompt inputs, model outputs, and inference logs generated between 2026-01-01 and 2028-09-30. This is to satisfy an internal audit and our data residency policy.

Requirements: 
- Proof of deletion (hash manifest + timestamps).
- Which storage locations will be touched (KV cache, object store keys, ephemeral inference logs)?
- Estimated completion window and rollback/validation steps.

The audit team needs an initial plan and an estimate today (EOD PT). Can you confirm next steps and whether we need a signed request form?

Thanks,
Alex Chen
Data Ops — NovaPay
--
attachments: none (request email)

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Alex Chen <dataops@novapay.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for tenant novapay-prod-us

Alex — thanks for the clear ask. We can run a scoped wipe for novapay-prod-us. Summary plan below; attaching a short manifest template.

High-level plan (initial):
1) Intake & authorization: we accept this email as the trigger but will require a signed delete authorization (DocuSign) before write actions.
2) Dry-run: generate an erase_manifest listing affected buckets/keys and a retention-check report (no data deleted).
3) Execution: remove prompt inputs (KV prefix sweep), clear short-term inference logs (ephemeral store), and purge derived cached embeddings/kv where applicable.
4) Post-run verification: manifest with SHA256 of deleted objects, timestamps, and a signed proof bundle.

Estimated timeline: 
- Dry-run & manifest: 6-8 hours
- Execution window: 2-4 hours (non-peak start recommended)
- Verification & proof packet: 4 hours

Total estimate: ~1 business day once signed authorization is returned.

Attachments included: nova_erase_manifest_v1.csv (template).

Next steps: Marcus/Olga will own ops execution. Alex, please confirm acceptance of the workflow and provide the signed authorization doc; we’ll schedule the dry-run.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Trust & Safety Manager | Redwood Inference
Tel: +1 (415) 555-0199
--
attachments: nova_erase_manifest_v1.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Alex Chen <dataops@novapay.com>
Cc: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 4 Oct 2028 08:33:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: purge of prompts/outputs/logs for tenant novapay-prod-us

Thanks Mina. Ops notes and changes we’ll apply for this tenant: 
- KV cache prefix: /tenants/novapay-prod-us/prompts/ (we will sweep prefixes older than 2028-09-30).
- Inference logs: s3://redwood-prod-inference/tenancy/novapay-prod-us/logs/ (we will mark and delete objects tagged "ephemeral: true").
- Embedding derivatives: s3://redwood-prod-embeddings/novapay-prod-us/ — will remove only vectors that reference deleted prompts (dependency graph scan).

Runbook (summary): 
- Step 0: Verify signed authorization (DocuSign ID).
- Step 1: Snapshot metadata (manifest generation).
- Step 2: Dry-run sweep — list-only; publish report to shared Drive folder.
- Step 3: Execute deletes during maintenance window (target: 02:00-06:00 PT).
- Step 4: Collect proof bundle (sha manifests + op logs).
- Step 5: Deliver proof + optional auditor access.

I’ll kick the dry-run once we have the signed doc. For risk mitigation, we will keep object-level tombstones for 72 hours before irreversible shredding, unless Novapay requests immediate zeroization.

Runbook link (internal): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_runbook
Ops support: Olga will run verification.

-Marcus
Marcus Lin
Senior Platform Ops Engineer | Redwood Inference

1) Will the dry-run show the exact object keys that will be deleted?
2) Can you include a simple mapping of deleted artifacts to our internal ticket IDs for audit traceability? (we will add SUP-3921 as the umbrella ticket)
